title: Mercy brings the Name home
summary: Bliss, poise, and the Name are not conquered by self-improvement. When the Master is merciful, Naam comes home to the mind.
takeaway: Ask mercy to make the mind a home for Naam.
lifeApplication: Before turning practice into a progress report, soften the demand to master yourself. Ask the Lord to let Naam enter the inner room you cannot force open.

source.shortMeaning: The Name enters the home of the mind when the Master shows mercy.
source.lifeApplication: When practice becomes self-measurement, ask mercy to make the mind hospitable to Naam.

evidence.coreClaim: The Name enters the home of the mind when the Master shows mercy.
evidence.turn: The lines move from chanting peace and poise into the mercy that brings Naam inside.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before turning practice into a progress report, soften the demand to master yourself. Ask the Lord to let Naam enter the inner room you cannot force open.
